title: City Council District 3
statement: San Antonio’s numbers don’t lie: 0.42 sentiment vs the city’s 0.51, a 0.79 crime index that outpaces Oakland’s 0.709 average, and decay momentum ticking at 3. This isn’t just data—it’s the lived reality of folks like Dank Abara at the diner, Delia Vargas-Ruiz at the transit hub, and Jamal Thompson writing truth into the Echo. We don’t abandon neighborhoods because they’re inconvenient. We invest. I’ll stand with San Antonio until its streets reflect the care we’d demand for Rockridge or Lake Merritt. No district gets left behind.
action: Commit to San Antonio’s revitalization through targeted funding and community-led initiatives.
